h1: JLC Digital Manufacturing Achieves PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 Certification

headings.text: JLC Digital Manufacturing Achieves PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 Certification
Strengthening Payment Security for Global Customers

meta_description: JLC payment security protects global online transactions with PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 certification. Order securely today!
monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLC Digital Manufacturing Achieves PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 Certification JLC Digital Manufacturing Achieves PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 Certification Press Release Jul 24, 2026 Table of Contents Strengthening Payment Security for Global Customers Secure Payment Infrastructure Supporting Secure Digital Manufacturing About JLC Digital Manufacturing JLC Digital Manufacturing has achieved Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0.1 Level 1 certification , the highest level of PCI DSS compliance. The certification covers the company's major overseas business platforms, including JLCCNC, JLCPCB, JLC3DP, and JLCMC , reinforcing payment security and data protection for customers worldwide. The certification was independently assessed by atsec information security , a Qualified Security Assessor (QSA). This achievement builds upon JLC Digital Manufacturing's previously obtained ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System and ISO/IEC 27701:2019 Privacy Information Management System certifications, further strengthening the company's information security governance framework and its commitment to secure cross-border digital services. Strengthening Payment Security for Global Customers PCI DSS is the internationally recognized security standard established by major international payment card brands, including Visa and MasterCard, to protect payment card information. Version 4.0.1 establishes comprehensive security requirements covering areas such as network protection, encryption, access control, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and governance. By achieving PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 certification, JLC Digital Manufacturing demonstrates that its payment security controls have been independently assessed against internationally recognized industry standards. For customers, this certification provides additional confidence that payment information is protected according to globally accepted security requirements throughout the online transaction process. Secure Payment Infrastructure JLC Digital Manufacturing protects online payments through industry-standard encryption, secure tokenization technologies, and trusted payment service providers, including Stripe and PayPal. The company's payment architecture is designed to protect cardholder information during transmission while reducing the handling of sensitive payment data within its own systems. In accordance with PCI DSS requirements, JLC Digital Manufacturing does not store unencrypted cardholder data, helping minimize potential security risks. These security measures support the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of payment information for customers conducting business through the company's global digital platforms. Supporting Secure Digital Manufacturing As AI technologies and intelligent manufacturing continue to accelerate the evolution of the electronics industry, cybersecurity and payment security have become increasingly important across global supply chains. For JLC Digital Manufacturing, protecting customer information and enabling secure online transactions are fundamental to delivering reliable digital manufacturing services. With internationally recognized certifications including ISO/IEC 27001 , ISO/IEC 27701 , and PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 , JLC Digital Manufacturing will continue enhancing its security capabilities while providing trusted services for engineers, innovators, and businesses worldwide. About JLC Digital Manufacturing Founded in 2006, JLC Digital Manufacturing provides integrated electronics and mechanical manufacturing services to more than 9.5 million customers across over 180 countries and regions . Its ecosystem includes JLCCNC for CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication, EasyEDA for PCB design, JLCPCB for PCB fabrication, component sourcing, and PCB assembly, JLC3DP for additive manufacturing, and JLCMC for mechanical components, enabling customers to move from prototype to production through a full-stack digital manufacturing platform. For JLCCNC customers, this certification provides additional assurance that online payment information is protected according to internationally recognized security standards.
